findings.evidence: Mathlib `Inversion/Basic.lean:44` defines `inversion c R x := (R / dist x c)^2 • (x -ᵥ c) +ᵥ c`, equal over `ℂ` to `c + R² / conj (x-c)`. Existing replacements include `inversion_self` (line 68), `inversion_of_mem_sphere` (89), `dist_inversion_center` (94), `inversion_inversion`/`inversion_involutive` (110/119), `inversion_injective` (125), `inversion_eq_center` (131), and `ContinuousAt.inversion`/`ContinuousOn.inversion` (220/225).
findings.fix: Import `Mathlib.Geometry.Euclidean.Inversion.Basic`, use `EuclideanGeometry.inversion c r`, and retain only a bridging lemma proving its complex conjugate-reciprocal formula plus genuinely circle-reflection-specific wrappers if needed by consumers.
findings.issue: `circleReflection` is exactly `EuclideanGeometry.inversion c r` specialized to `ℂ`; the file then rederives its center, distance, involution, injectivity, sphere-fixation, and continuity API.

summary: The proposed circle reflection directly duplicates Mathlib’s existing sphere inversion on the complex Euclidean plane, including most of its API.
